name: Marvin R. Ellison

career.title: Operational roles incl. President - Northern Division and SVP - Global Logistics

background_rationale: Built his career in retail store operations, logistics and loss prevention at Target and Home Depot, where he ran U.S. stores, before becoming CEO of J.C. Penney and Lowe's.

notable.summary: Lowe's agreed to sell its Canadian retail business to Sycamore Partners for $400 million, a sale completed in February 2023.
Lowe's agreed to acquire Foundation Building Materials for $8.8 billion in cash to expand its business serving contractors and builders.
Lowe's announced it had become the first home improvement retailer to offer drone delivery.

personal_story.hook: One of seven children in Brownsville, Tennessee, Marvin Ellison went on to lead two Fortune 500 retailers.
personal_story.summary: Ellison grew up poor in Brownsville, Tennessee, one of seven children, while his father worked multiple jobs. His family performed as a gospel act, and he has remained a musician. He worked his way through the University of Memphis, an experience he has said shaped his corporate career, and then spent 15 years in operations at Target and 12 at Home Depot, where he ran U.S. stores. He became CEO of J.C. Penney in 2015 and of Lowe's in 2018, and Lowe's describes him as the only African American to serve as chairman and CEO of two Fortune 500 companies.
